title: Finite-stage cancelled composition equation
statement: The cancelled composition equation holds for an integral constructible representative at every finite coefficient stage.

proof.text: Substitute the integral formulas at a fixed finite stage, apply cochain tensor coherence and the integral inverse-image comparison compositor, and cancel the finite-stage comparison.
